about: A pushed commit's Release-note trailer cannot be rewritten, because main is never force pushed. Where one was wrong, the note that replaces it is written here, by the commit's full hash, and scripts/release-notes.py reads it in the trailer's place. Each says why.

f1d775ea501a92b9f98c0335192b0da02aca6f02.why: Entry 266's README commit said the application did not change, but it also changed one word in the volunteer pack, which ships; nightly 120 refused it.

notes.note: The printed volunteer pack's ruler check now spells center the American way, as the rest of GroupLab does. (Entry 266)
